templates.name: Mutual NDA
templates.description: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement created by a committee of over 40 attorneys representing technology vendors, procurement teams, and law firms. Allows parties to protect confidential information in business discussions.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA that incorporates the standard terms. Used to specify parties, effective date, term, governing law, and jurisdiction.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
templates.description: Comprehensive agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products. Includes provisions for service access, restrictions, payment, term, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for early product access and feedback partnerships. Allows vendors to give design partners early access to products in exchange for feedback to improve the product for general use.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
templates.description: Defines service level commitments and remedies for cloud service providers. Specifies uptime targets, response time commitments, and service credit calculations.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
templates.description: Standard framework for service delivery and consulting engagements. Includes provisions for services, deliverables, intellectual property, payment, and termination.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
templates.description: Comprehensive framework for GDPR and data protection compliance. Incorporates EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and UK Addendum for lawful international data transfers.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Comprehensive framework for software licensing and delivery. Covers software installation, use limitations, updates, support services, and open source compliance.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard framework for business partnerships and collaborations. Covers partnerships, reseller agreements, affiliate programs, channel partnerships, and brand licensing.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
templates.description: Standard framework for HIPAA compliance. Compliant with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy Rule and Security Rule for handling protected health information.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Standard framework for trial and evaluation periods. Used when a prospective customer wants to test a product or service before committing to a longer-term commercial agreement.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Standard framework for artificial intelligence and machine learning components in agreements. Addresses legal and commercial considerations of AI services including model training, output ownership, and accuracy disclaimers.
